// Positive years: every multiple of 4 is a leap year assertTrue(JulianChronology.INSTANCE.isLeapYear(8)); assertFalse(JulianChronology.INSTANCE.isLeapYear(7));
// Year 0 (proleptic) is divisible by 4 and is therefore a leap year assertTrue(JulianChronology.INSTANCE.isLeapYear(0));
